dedupe_keys.name: 定時路線ハス一覧 bus and public transit

description: 定時路線バス一覧 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 茅野市. 茅野駅周辺の定時路線バスです。 茅野・上諏訪・下諏訪・岡谷線、美濃戸口線を掲載しています。. Coverage: 茅野市. The portal files it under the publisher 茅野市. Its tags are バス, 位置情報, 定時路線. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-02-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
